result_sentence: Boosted trees was selected using validation MSE. On the four-day test, its R² relative to a zero-return forecast was 4.416%, and its MSE was 4.437% lower than the price-control Ridge model.
cost_sentence: At a one-second assumed entry delay and one basis point of fees per side, the mean hypothetical five-second round trip was -1.9405 bps across 6,091 eligible decisions.
